results.note: Inverts held-edits detection: pristine copies get flagged as carrying edits, and genuinely edited files get the silent 'unmodified' message.
Flips the 'untouched' policy: locally-modified files get staged for removal while pristine ones are kept -- the exact opposite of the guarantee.
Reports the loud 'YOUR EDITS went with it' warning for exactly the wrong set of files.
Swaps the kept/pending buckets for unstaged removals, so the report tells the user the opposite of what happened.
Boundary shift: n == 0 renders '0 setting' instead of '0 settings'.
plan_config writes its OWN wording instead of the shared one -- the exact regression the consolidation removed.
load() reverts to the parser's class name, re-opening the two-qualities-of-message defect.
Inverted membership guard: known keys are rejected as unknown and unknown keys are written straight into the config.
Swaps the ahead/behind tuple slots, so status offers `ccs git push` when the checkout is behind and `--pull` when it is ahead.
and/or swap: a one-sided behind or ahead takes the divergence branch, so the targeted fast-forward and push advice is never reached.
Off-by-one on both pluralisation boundaries, which also desynchronises noun and verb agreement above ahead == 1.
Dropped existence guard: the unknown-keys warning can fire for a config file that is not there.
Drops the column padding on one leg only, breaking alignment between the live-only and checkout rows.
A third hand-written copy of the not-an-object sentence, agreeing with nothing.
